The '''''Onasi''''' was a warship in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] that was under [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Oteg]]'s command at the [[Battle of the Maelstrom]] in the early days of the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR:MP" />
